Generative AI Policy

You may use ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, or similar AI tools to help you understand concepts and debug code on homeworks and projects. You must cite any AI tool you used in a comment at the top of your notebook. AI tools are not allowed on exams. Be careful: these tools are often confidently wrong.

Academic Integrity

Copying solutions from other students is cheating.
